snippet.title: Benji Challenges // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/393770/Benji_Challenges

Benji Challenges is a fun and casual platformer where you control the monkey Benji, swinging from vine to vine. Features gorgeous graphics, intuitive control mechanics and 50 hand-crafted levels of challenging gameplay!

👥 Players: Single-player
🛠️ Developer: Tribeflame
📚 Publisher: Benji Bananas
📅 Release Date: Mar 24, 2016
🎯 Genre: Action, Adventure
